say:4:1321014002:1.text: I-I'm fine... I'm so sorry for making everyone worry...
say:4:1321014002:1.source_cn: 没、没事……对不起，让各位担心了……

say:5:1321014003:1.text: Phew, I'm just glad you're safe...

say:6:1321014004:1.text: It seems like Mister Teapot really cares about you! He was the fastest to run here!
say:6:1321014004:1.source_cn: 这么看来，茶壶先生还是很关心奇花的嘛！我们一路上追过来...

say:9:1321014005:1.text: Yeah, Mister Teapot was so fast, his face turned bright red. It's like he was boiling with concern!
say:9:1321014005:1.source_cn: 是啊，茶壶先生跑得脸都红了，好像连脑袋里的茶都重新热起...

say:11:1321014007:1.text: *Sigh* Why are you thanking me? I should be the one apologizing.
say:11:1321014007:1.source_cn: 唉，你谢我做什么……应该我向你道歉才对。

say:12:1321014008:1.text: I shouldn't have been so mean to you earlier. After all, preserving the tea leaves is my job, and if they turned bitter, it's on me.
say:12:1321014008:1.source_cn: 对不起，刚才我不该那样训斥你。毕竟保存茶叶是我的职责，...

say:13:1321014009:1.source_cn: 不是的，茶壶先生……那不是你的错。

say:14:1321014010:1.text: I just remembered... I never got around to honey-preserving the petals I picked a few days ago.
say:14:1321014010:1.source_cn: 我刚刚才想起来，前几天新摘的那些花瓣，还没来得及蜜渍……

say:16:1321014012:1.text: That's right. Only honey-preserved petals can be used for tea... Honey locks in the fragrance and removes the bitterness.
say:16:1321014012:1.source_cn: 是的。只有经过蜜渍的花瓣才能作为茶叶……既能保留花香，...

say:17:1321014013:1.text: I... I just remembered... Sorry, it's all my fault...
say:17:1321014013:1.source_cn: 我、我刚刚才想起来……对不起，都是我的错……

say:20:1321014014:1.text: That explains everything! No wonder the tea tasted so bitter!
say:20:1321014014:1.source_cn: 原来是这样！难怪前两壶茶喝起来会是苦的！

say:21:1321014015:1.text: But I've never done anything like that before! Why didn't the previous batches of tea taste bitter?
say:21:1321014015:1.source_cn: 可是，我从没做过这样的事！为什么以前的花瓣茶叶没有苦味？

say:22:1321014016:1.text: That's because every time I picked the petals, I would soak them in honey right away and store them with tea leaves by the next morning.
say:22:1321014016:1.source_cn: 我……每次采回花瓣之后，都会将它们浸泡起来，第二天早上...

say:23:1321014017:1.text: But a few days ago, when I returned to the manor, His Lordship asked me to find some missing paint. After that, I completely forgot about the petals...
say:23:1321014017:1.source_cn: 但是前几天，我刚回到庄园，子爵先生就说有一支颜料不见了...

say:24:1321014018:1.text: So, this is why I always see you hanging around the tea storage area?

say:25:1321014019:1.text: Yes, and this is the first time I forgot. I'm sorry, Mister Teapot...
say:25:1321014019:1.source_cn: 嗯，我只忘过这一次！抱歉，茶壶先生……

say:28:1321014020:1.text: It seems Mister Flower has been doing a lot more work behind the scenes than we realized.
say:28:1321014020:1.source_cn: 看来奇花默默做了很多工作呢。

say:29:1321014021:1.text: I finally understand why His Lordship chose you.
say:29:1321014021:1.source_cn: 难怪……我终于理解子爵先生为什么会选中你了。

say:30:1321014022:1.text: What do you mean by that...?

say:31:1321014023:1.text: What I mean is, you're not completely without merit.
say:31:1321014023:1.source_cn: 我的意思是——咳，你也不是完全没有可取之处。

choice_prompt:32:1321014023.text: What I mean is, you're not completely without merit.
choice_prompt:32:1321014023.source_cn: 我的意思是——咳，你也不是完全没有可取之处。

say:34:1321014026:1.text: It's dangerous to be out here. We should head back to the manor right away. Let me check the time...
say:34:1321014026:1.source_cn: 庄园外并不安全，我们还是尽快返回吧。让我看看时间……

say:35:1321014027:1.text: Oh my, it's already tea time! Mister Flower, this is your chance to shine.
say:35:1321014027:1.source_cn: 哎呀，已经到下午茶时间了。奇花，现在是你体现价值的时候了。

say:36:1321014028:1.text: Y-you want me to prepare the afternoon tea?

say:37:1321014029:1.text: And don't forget to honey-preserve those bitter petals.
say:37:1321014029:1.source_cn: 还要记得把苦涩的花瓣拿去蜜渍。

say:38:1321014030:1.text: Of course... thank you, Mister Teapot!

choice:32:0:1.text: It means he's realized his mistake.
choice:32:0:1.source_cn: 意思是他认识到了自己的错误
choice:32:0:1.male: It means he's realized his mistake.
choice:32:0:1.female: It means he's realized his mistake.

say:40:1321014025:1.text: Well, when it comes to His Lordship and distinguished guests, I always try to maintain my composure and behave nicely.
say:40:1321014025:1.source_cn: 或许是吧。但是对待子爵先生和尊贵的客人，我一直都很有风度。
say:40:1321014025:1.male: Well, when it comes to His Lordship and distinguished guests, I always try to maintain my composure and behave nicely.
say:40:1321014025:1.female: Well, when it comes to His Lordship and distinguished guests, I always try to maintain my composure and behave nicely.

choice:32:1:2.text: Have you always been this mean?
choice:32:1:2.source_cn: 你一向说话都是这个风格吗？
choice:32:1:2.male: Have you always been this mean?
choice:32:1:2.female: Have you always been this mean?
